lockedOriginal.contract: callBackBookInternal 144-167: actual nonnull source/book, eventListener and callBackJs gate, async notification, 60 second task; source.evalJS binds event/result/book/chapter. No login-page java substitution, InfoMap bind, result conversion, isTrue/UI fallback or final Book/Chapter update.

entryAndAuthority: ReaderView+SourceCallBack start/end/save and OnlineBookView addBookShelf pass the actual BookStore. The default source fetcher is the same shared instance already selected by AppDependencies.live.
SourceCallBackService.notify returns its actual cancellable task; the four migrated events always call mainJSService.originalBookCallback and never recover through the old JSC runner.

The same source actor acquires its existing source lock and accepts its immutable source signature. Native execution reuses the sole process, source.evalJS/Rhino, JVM HTTP, Cookie and PersistentStateHost.

A real App book UUID/source/bookURL is required. A chapter notification also passes the exact existing chapter UUID/index/URL; the existing store is re-read before binding. URL/DTO alone grants nothing.

AppLegadoBookStateOwner adds a task-bound metadata-only callback authority. It reads and commits small/large entity variables through the existing snapshot/revision writer and cancellation tickets. It grants no content owner, generation, TOC/body save or cache path.

Native execution awaits the existing runtime cancellation/drain and close, revokes the same Host grant and returns actual acknowledged effects. A failed/cancelled notification does not trigger UI default actions. Already acknowledged writes are not rolled back.

fieldsAndRealSources.bookIdentity: Existing App ReadingBook UUID is native-only authority; bookUrl/source origin/tocUrl are checked against its actual runtime snapshot. Name/author/cover use the actual event book snapshot; source originName/customOrder come from the immutable source.
fieldsAndRealSources.startRead: Wait until Reader restoration is complete and send once per ReaderView. Read the current visible-engine or existing session Navigator (spineIndex,charOffset); select the event chapter from the same position and existing TOC.
fieldsAndRealSources.saveRead: Same position snapshot and exact stored chapter ID. noteSaveRead captures timestamp once, using the identical canonical decimal milliseconds for result and book.durChapterTime. The service rejects disagreement.
fieldsAndRealSources.endRead: Existing actual close signal, current visible-engine/Navigator position and matching persisted chapter. History time comes from the actual event ReadingBook.lastOpenedDate, or its real addedDate when no opened date exists. The callback does not change the position or stored dates.
fieldsAndRealSources.addBookShelf: After the actual BookStore shelf transition and original preview transfer, loadChecked on the same injected dependencies.readingPositionStore supplies the exact already-written position. Map book.durChapterIndex/title to the existing TOC while chapter stays null. ENOENT allows initial zero only for an App record defined as never read (lastOpenedDate=nil,currentPosition=0); an existing unknown position is a typed failure.
fieldsAndRealSources.durChapterPos: Exact charOffset copied from the current Reader event or same actual position owner; bounded nonnegative Int32, no page/fraction conversion.
fieldsAndRealSources.durChapterTime: saveRead uses the exact same event timestamp as result. startRead/endRead/addBookShelf project the actual event ReadingBook.lastOpenedDate ?? addedDate, converted to nonnegative finite Int64 milliseconds with a checked conversion. The App opened-date fact is not a claim to independently retain Android last-save history. No notification wall-clock time is substituted; no new timestamp store/schema is added.
fieldsAndRealSources.order: Physical ordering offset of this actual book from the existing bounded runtimeRecordIndex; no new index. Android manual order/sort settings are not imported by this adapter.
fieldsAndRealSources.imageStyle: Existing retained book.imageStyle runtime value, if present, projected to the original getImageStyle/setImageStyle Java-bean contract. Without a per-book value the original nullable config default remains nil. Setting it within this detached callback has no automatic final App metadata write.
fieldsAndRealSources.variables: Exact original small/large string companion semantics through the same BookStore/ChapterStore owners, excluding the private context reference. App CAS immediately persists variable mutations; the original source only mutates its live small map and immediately writes large companions, and has no final callback flush.
fieldsAndRealSources.otherDTOFields: Existing finite retained original Book/BookChapter fields remain available. This delta adds durChapterPos/durChapterTime/order/get-setImageStyle; it does not claim the whole Android Book/readConfig/method surface.

honestRemainingBoundaries: Only traditional text sources and actual online text-book entities are covered. mainJs and audio/manga/fixed/native-local body modes fail typed UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY for these four notifications; they never execute old JSC as a fallback.

Tap/custom-button, delete and shelf-refresh callbacks, intro/review/login/browser/UI hosts remain outside this delta and still have their previous paths. The source-only shelf-refresh fake-empty-book route is not claimed fixed.
No new InfoMap lifecycle registration: locked callBackBook does not explicitly bind or create an exploration context; the existing App pause registry remains its sole original exploration owner.
refreshBookInfo/TOC/content, browser, login-info and other absent original hosts stay unsupported. This work does not emulate their effects.

Direct book/chapter DTO field assignments are transient; no returned DTO is adopted or used to write metadata/progress/body. The notification authored return is ignored, including nonserializable Java objects.
No Swift compiler/SDK/JNI/UI execution on Windows. Two actual-native fixture methods are definitions only; final centralized SDK/JNI validation is required.

sectionReview.identityAndCAS: Actual book/source/chapter owner checked before JNI; matching callback task ID enforced on entity requests; existing per-transaction revision CAS and cancellation lifetime reused. No simulated fetch generation or body grant.
sectionReview.progress: Read-only position from the same owner or actual Reader Navigator. No callback save/flush. Existing unknown position cannot silently become chapter zero. Non-save read history uses actual book opened/added metadata, with finite/range checks. Existing native definition now sets a real stored historical opened date, checks all three non-save events, then checks the actual added-date branch; saveRead still checks exact result/time equality. Native execution remains pending.
sectionReview.threading: Position reads/DTO encoding/source execution run off main in the existing actor/runtime/file owners. UI copies scalar session state and passes immutable inputs; no new View/init I/O or library-sized main loop.
sectionReview.terminalPaths: Authored errors, unsupported modes, source/chapter conflicts, absolute timeout and cancellation remain typed. Session close/revocation runs after terminal execution; actual prefix effects survive later errors.
sectionReview.staticLimit: Swift tree-sitter root checks report no error for 16 candidate Swift sources except AudiobookView, whose canonical baseline already has has_error=true; its two notify argument hunks were manually compared. Detailed tree-sitter child/query traversal crashed its Windows native extension; no compiler result is inferred.

v2Fix.finding: durChapterTime must not use unrelated notification time
v2Fix.resolution: Only saveRead captures the current event timestamp. Other notifications map actual book history dates and reject unrepresentable metadata. The native fixture writes fixed historical opened/added dates through the actual BookStore before notifying. No Kotlin input or method count changed.

sourceReview.initialFinding: One P1: non-save notifications substituted notification time for existing reading history.
sourceReview.resolution: Root reviewed the exact three-source v1-to-v2 delta: only saveRead captures its single actual event timestamp and requires the same result; other notifications use checked actual lastOpenedDate or addedDate. The native fixture stores historical dates through the real BookStore and checks each non-save event and the added-date branch. No new date store/schema or Kotlin changes.

actualJVM.earlierAttempts: Default 512MiB test VM could not allocate. Validation-only 128MiB SerialGC runs executed three tests; first corrected fixture Java-wrapper strict-equality / Gson-key assumptions, then all three passed. Final progress fields caused the last necessary three-test rerun, also all passed.

regressions.grammar: No new tree-sitter root errors; AudiobookView baseline already has a grammar root error. Source screening is not compilation.
